subject: geom_sinaplot. Advice on a new geom.

messages.author: 7086e0fa7affea76
messages.subject: geom_sinaplot. Advice on a new geom.
parts:
Hi everyone,

I have implemented a visualisation method in R for multi-class data called sinaplot. 
The main (and only public) function of the package transforms the input data and then uses ggplot to visualise them.

I am trying to write a geom_sinaplot but I'm a bit overwhelmed with the format. So far I have read these guidelines which are quite helpful but I'm not sure where to start.
Will I need to write a new stat? Should I use some geom(s) as a template?

Any advice is very welcome! 

Bests,
Nikos

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: geom_sinaplot. Advice on a new geom.
parts:
That looks most like a stat or position adjustment to me, so I'd start there.

Hadley

PS. If you haven't already, you should consider submitting a short
paper on this visualising to JCGS.
